texto: Ya tengo los 27 criterios. Antes de decidir necesito estimar la HU, así que consulto la escala y las referencias.
pensamiento:
I'm checking the user story against each criterion. QUS-001 and QUS-003 pass, and QUS-002 seems fine too since activating and deactivating are the same toggle feature. I'm now looking at QUS-004, the benefit clause about using it when traveling and locking it otherwise.

I'm checking the benefit clause in QUS-004 about bloquear, and I think it still reads as a real reason to use the card while traveling, so it passes. Moving on to QUS-005, the criteria look more like system behavior than a solution, so that passes too. For QUS-006, the vague "versiones que soporta la app" in the criteria is the thing I'm weighing next.

I'm going through the remaining checks: QUS-006 through QUS-009 all hold, since the HU text itself has no vague terms and the format is consistent. The processor is named as a dependency in the criteria, so INV-001 passes too, and the benefit is explicit, so INV-002 passes. Now I'm moving on to INV-003, the estimability check.

I'm weighing whether the remaining INV-003 questions, like the undefined app versions and the default state of international purchases, leave the story estimable. The bigger issue is that the HU says "bloquearla" while the criteria only toggle international purchases, so the story itself seems to describe two different things.

I'm weighing whether the "bloquearla" wording in the benefit clause is a real defect. It could be read as blocking the entire card, while the criteria only toggle international purchases, so QUS-006 likely fails on ambiguity, and I'm leaning toward marking it as a major issue.

I'm weighing whether the "bloquearla" in the benefit clause is a separate objective from the international-purchase toggle, which would make QUS-004 fail as a single-purpose story. I'm leaning toward flagging it there, since blocking the card is a distinct functionality.

I'm checking the default-state question for the cards and the error cases, and I'm leaning toward counting the timeout and error handling as covered. Next I'm moving on to the non-functional criteria, where the 15-second timeout is already a measurable target.

I'm checking the sensitivity criterion, since changing the card's state might need biometric or password confirmation, and the criteria do require one. For session handling, the story doesn't touch login or navigation, so that check likely doesn't apply. Now I'm weighing whether the notification pushed after the change exposes the full card number or only the last four digits.

I'm now checking whether the push notification after the card change masks the card number, since the HU doesn't say what the push contains. The criteria require masking anywhere sensitive data is shown or sent, and the audit record already shows only the masked card, so the push content is the gap. I'm leaning toward flagging the push masking as an undefined, blocking issue.

I'm looking at the accessibility check next, since the story changes the card screen and the criteria don't mention it, so that looks like a minor gap. I'm also checking the error handling for the card state, where the timeout is already set and nothing changes on failure, so that check holds.

I'm now checking the offline case: the story doesn't say what happens without a network, but the 15-second timeout already covers the error path, so that holds. For the platform check, the criteria ask for minimum versions and the story doesn't give them, so I'm marking that as a minor gap. Last, the story doesn't collect any new personal data, since it only uses the card, so this check doesn't really apply.

I'm checking the SUGEF criterion next, since enabling international purchases changes what the card can do in transactions, and the story doesn't mention compliance validation. That's a gap I'd rate as major. The auth criteria look fine, so I'm moving on to the estimate.

texto: Estimación: 5 puntos. Hay varias integraciones (procesador, auditoría, push) y dos plataformas. La HU no cumple seis criterios, así que la decisión es devolver. Registro la revisión.
pensamiento:
I'm estimating this at 5 points because it spans several integration points: the processor, audit, push, and two platforms. The call is to send it back, since there are defects in QUS-004, QUS-006, BM-003, BM-006, BM-008, and BM-010. I also want to keep the recommendation texts in Spanish and free of personal data, and I'm refining the story around a mobile banking customer who wants to turn international purchases on and off with their debit card while traveling.

I'm settling on the story wording now: a mobile banking customer who wants to turn international purchases on and off with their debit card, so it works while traveling and stays off when they don't need it. I'm swapping "bloquearla" for "desactivar compras internacionales" so nothing beyond the original scope gets added. The acceptance criteria can stay empty, since the decision is to send it back.

recomendaciones.texto: El beneficio mezcla 'bloquearla cuando no la necesito', que describe otra funcionalidad (bloquear la tarjeta), con el objetivo de usarla al viajar. Reformule el 'para…' con un valor real, sin mencionar otra funcionalidad.

'Bloquear' se usa para referirse a desactivar las compras internacionales, pero en banca 'bloquear' puede entenderse como bloqueo total de la tarjeta. Use un único término y defina en la HU qué se bloquea o desactiva.
La notificación push confirma el cambio, pero no dice qué contiene. Defina que la push no muestra el número de tarjeta completo (solo los últimos 4 dígitos) y que no muestra otros datos sensibles.

La HU crea o cambia una pantalla (estado de compras internacionales por tarjeta). Agregue un criterio de accesibilidad (lector de pantalla, contraste, tamaño de texto, referencia WCAG 2.1 AA) o indique que la DoR del equipo ya lo incluye.
El criterio 'en las versiones que soporta la app' no indica versiones. Declare las versiones mínimas de iOS y Android. Indique también cómo se comporta el cambio en cada plataforma.

Activar o desactivar compras internacionales cambia una operación financiera. Indique la regla normativa SUGEF aplicable o que el cambio se valida con el área de Cumplimiento antes de pasar a la fábrica.
